compatibilityNotes: CoA-specific means the project README explicitly targets Conquest of Azeroth or its 21 custom classes; it is not a claim that every release was tested by BoneArchive.
Wrath 3.3.5a means the addon or profile targets the client generation used by Ascension. Class-aware functions and encounter timers may still need CoA-specific checks.
Do not install two full UI replacements or multiple addons that perform the same job without checking for conflicts. Review each author's install steps, requirements, release notes, and license.

The owned list mirrors all 17 add-on repositories in the GitHub account. A repository entry does not mean that it has a published release or live-client validation; check each project's current README and releases.

owned.name: Details

owned.name: SilverDragon

owned.name: AtlasLoot-CoA

owned.name: WeakAuras-CoA

owned.name: UnclePlus-CoA

owned.name: Refactor-CoA

addons.name: RetreatUI
addons.summary: Class-aware HUDs, resources, cooldowns, party utility, and per-build layouts. The CoA release requires RetreatUI_Classes and lists ElvUI, TurboPlates, MobSpells, and Details! as requirements; DBM integration is optional.

addons.name: CoA Cooldown Manager
addons.summary: Configurable spell, item, summon, totem, resource, aura, cooldown and HoT viewers with dropdown-based setup. Designed around Ascension's custom class, spell-ID, and resource behavior.

addons.name: GSE-CoA
addons.summary: Gnome Sequencer Enhanced adapted for Conquest of Azeroth, with sequence editing and macro compatibility features. Review the project's current release and its rules before using combat sequences.

addons.name: CoADamage
addons.summary: DRDamage-inspired testing tool that records direct, periodic, and ranged damage observations with crit, stats, and buff context for spell theorycrafting.

addons.name: SmartPVP
addons.maturity: Early release; author warns of bugs
addons.summary: Kill and match history, battleground/arena statistics, a session HUD, rivalries, leveling metrics, and an opt-in shared leaderboard. The author documents known CoA client limitations.

addons.name: OmniBarCOA
addons.summary: Conquest-focused OmniBar fork for tracking enemy cooldowns. Check the repository for current class/spell coverage and installation notes.

addons.name: AUX for CoA
addons.summary: Auction-house replacement that adds support for CoA custom item IDs, variants, qualities, required levels, and Ascension auction behavior.

addons.name: Ascension Auctionator
addons.summary: Auctionator port with a compatibility layer for the 3.3.5a client and CoA auction-house behavior. An alternative to AUX; choose one auction-house workflow and check current releases.

addons.name: HydroUI
addons.summary: ElvUI plugin that applies an original CoA-aware layout, themes, unit-frame styling, class/spec headers, and an installer. Requires an Ascension-compatible ElvUI installation.

addons.name: DragonUI-CoA
addons.summary: Modular DragonUI adaptation for CoA, with configurable components and import/export layout presets. A full UI replacement; avoid stacking it with another full replacement.

addons.name: CoA Loot Decider
addons.summary: Adaptive loot-comparison addon for Conquest of Azeroth. Check the repository for its supported item and stat behavior before relying on its recommendations.

addons.name: BloodforgedFilter
addons.summary: Hides Bloodforged or other chosen text from Auction House results. Small focused utility; verify it still matches the current auction-house addon and client.

addons.name: CoA Class Portraits
addons.summary: Rounded class portraits for CoA class identities in compatible Project Ascension unit frames.

addons.name: CoA-compatible 3.3.5a addon directory
addons.summary: Browse the wider CoA-tagged catalog for bags, action bars, maps, tooltips, professions, mail, and other utilities. Individual listings may target other Ascension realms or require CoA-specific checks.

addons.name: Bagnon
addons.summary: Combines bags and bank storage into searchable inventory windows. Does not add custom CoA item data by itself.

addons.name: AtlasLoot Enhanced
addons.summary: Browse encounter and dungeon loot tables. Treat stock tables as reference only where CoA content or item drops differ.

addons.name: Bartender 4
addons.summary: Reposition and configure action bars for the larger spellbooks of CoA. It does not provide class-specific spell tracking.

addons.name: OmniCC
addons.summary: Adds countdown numbers to cooldown icons. CoA Cooldown Manager notes it as an optional dependency for some countdown displays.

addons.name: Leatrix Plus
addons.summary: A configurable bundle of general interface and quality-of-life options for the 3.3.5 client.

addons.name: Mapster
addons.summary: Map display and navigation enhancements. Custom CoA cave and sub-zone data may depend on the selected map addon or plugin.

addons.name: RaidRecruiter
addons.maturity: Beta; live posting/trade behavior not yet confirmed by author
addons.summary: LFG feed, raid recruitment, role collection, loot-roll tracking, and pull timer. The author says some live-server behaviors still need testing.

addons.name: RaidLocks
addons.summary: Lists raid lockouts with difficulty, size, boss progress, and reset time in one panel.

addons.name: CoA gear planner
addons.summary: Plan a CoA class/spec, equipment, enchants, and stat weights in a browser; repository documents source-aware item data and an in-game exporter.

profiles.name: Minimalist ElvUI Profile 3.3.5
profiles.summary: A minimal ElvUI profile for Wrath private servers. Import through ElvUI; its class labels and class-specific styling are standard Wrath classes, so use it for layout only and adjust CoA units/classes yourself.

profiles.name: JDI ElvUI profile 3.3.5a
profiles.summary: A profile linked from a Wago Wrath aura entry, plus its shared media pack. Verify the profile version against your installed Ascension ElvUI before importing.

profiles.name: ElvUIBackport Profile Converter
profiles.compatibility: Profile conversion utility · not a CoA profile
profiles.summary: Converts modern Wago ElvUI profile exports to the older 3.3.5-compatible format. Converted profiles still need review; modern widgets and class-specific settings may not map.

profileSources.name: Wago UI Packs
profileSources.summary: Wago offers profiles and WeakAura bundles in UI packs, but its published client support list does not include Ascension's custom 3.3.5a client. Use only individually identified Wrath-era profile data, not a one-click Wago UI pack for CoA.

profileSources.name: Warperia CoA addon directory
profileSources.summary: A CoA-filtered catalog of 3.3.5 addons and tools. Individual addon pages provide their own version and source links.

profileSources.name: GitHub CoA / Ascension addon search
profileSources.summary: Searchable project index; check each repository's README, release history, dependencies, and license before installation.
